_about: Boomertang issues (docs/specs/boomertang.md §4a). Public metadata only, drafts included. textInRepo: the issue's pages are Markdown in site/src/content/boomertang/<id>/ (always public; its access switch is locked on). Without it the text is members-only, in gitignored files under functions/scripts/data/boomertang/<id>/, seeded into Firestore. sample: true marks test issues: built off production only, seeded on staging with --samples. Sources: url is null until it's filled in (The Index shows the title without a link). games: the Game Vault slugs the issue covers (their game pages link to it once it is published). Facts on No. 1 were sourced Oct 15, 2026.
